assertions.title: Budget alert triggered by transaction creation

steps.action: Reset alert states in DB, set budget to $20,000 for March 2026
steps.expected: All thresholds reset to false; spending $887.99 = 4.44% of $20,000 (well below 50%)
steps.observed: DB updated; dashboard shows Budget=$20,000, Spent=$887.99, Usage=4.4%

steps.action: Reload browser — confirm no alerts fire on WS connection
steps.expected: No alert toasts appear since spending < 50%
steps.observed: Page loaded with no toast notifications appearing

steps.action: Navigate to Transactions page and create transaction: title='FLOW-WS-CrossTest threshold', amount=$10,100, date=2026-03-23, category=Food, notes='WS threshold test'
steps.expected: Transaction created; total spending = $887.99 + $10,100 = $10,987.99 = 54.94% of $20,000 → crosses 50% threshold
steps.observed: Transaction created successfully (API returned transaction ID 1387 with amount=$10,100). Toast 'Info: Budget 50% - You have spent 50% of your monthly budget. $10987.99 of $20000.00 spent.' appeared immediately after submission

evidence.network: POST /api/transactions -> 201 (transaction ID 1387); WS alert frame delivered to /user/topic/budget-alerts with threshold=50, currentSpending=10987.99, budgetAmount=20000.00

frictions.description: The parent task plan assumed alerts would fire on WS connection when all thresholds are already fired (spending $887.99 >> $100 budget). However, the backend only fires alerts for thresholds NOT yet marked as fired in budget_alert_states table. When all 3 thresholds were already fired, no alerts were sent on subscription. Had to manually reset the DB alert states before testing.
frictions.resolution: Used docker compose exec postgres psql to reset threshold_50_fired, threshold_80_fired, threshold_100_fired to false before testing Phase 1.

frictions.description: The budget PUT endpoint referenced in the test plan does not exist. The BudgetController only has POST (createOrUpdate) and GET endpoints.
frictions.resolution: Used POST /api/budgets instead of PUT /api/budgets/{id} to update the budget to $20,000.

frictions.description: Toast notifications auto-dismiss after ~8 seconds. The initial approach of waiting 3 seconds after page load missed the toasts entirely. Had to use rapid screenshots at ~800ms after page load to capture them.
frictions.resolution: Used agent-browser wait 800 immediately after reload to catch toasts before they dismiss.

summary: Tested 6 assertions: all 6 passed. VAL-WS-001 confirmed WebSocket connection via SockJS/STOMP with successful alert delivery. VAL-WS-003/004/005 confirmed all three threshold alerts (50%/80%/100%) appear as toasts when thresholds are crossed (verified by resetting DB state and reconnecting). VAL-WS-010 confirmed alerts are rendered as visible categorized toast notifications with severity styling. VAL-CROSS-005 confirmed that creating a transaction crossing the 50% threshold triggers an immediate WebSocket alert toast in the UI.
